question: UP-24 restores perfect decoding with a hand-constructed transport-commuting Weyl algebra. What experiment should follow?
evidence: The hand-constructed commuting observable algebra gives perfect training, unseen-depth, and mutable integration performance.
The algebra was built using known six-fold multiplicity structure, so the decisive representation was supplied by the experimenter.
The recurrent state remains fully mixed; the unresolved question is whether the useful invariant algebra can be obtained without hidden structural knowledge.
constraints: Do not claim autonomous discovery from a hand-specified algebra.
Do not expose the hidden multiplicity factorization or full-state mixer to the discovery procedure.
Freeze discovered observables before downstream task evaluation.

candidates.proposal: Promote the hand-built Weyl algebra as the final architecture because all current gates passed.
Tune a smaller subset of the known Weyl operators against held-out task accuracy.
Discover candidate commuting observables from the full transport itself, without hidden factorization or mixer access, freeze them, and then evaluate task decoding.
Restore semantic channel labels so the observer can directly identify each historical block.

expected_why: The next causal question is autonomous discovery of the useful commutant structure, not another hand-designed observer.
